name: Cryogenic LOX Sphere & RP-1 Tank Farm
summary: Ground storage and subcooling farm supplying densified liquid oxygen (LOX) and rocket-grade kerosene (RP-1) to Falcon 9 prior to liftoff.
function: Stores bulk LOX and RP-1, chills propellants through liquid-nitrogen heat exchangers, and pumps subcooled propellants into both stages starting ~T-35 min.
materials: Vacuum-jacketed double-walled stainless-steel cryogenic LOX sphere, insulated horizontal RP-1 and LN2 pressure vessels, and vacuum-jacketed transfer lines.

specs.label: LC-39A LOX Sphere Capacity
specs.source: NASA KSC LC-39A LOX sphere (~900,000 gal)

specs.label: Subcooled LOX Temperature
specs.source: SpaceX Falcon 9 Full Thrust / Block 5 densified LOX (~66 K)

specs.label: Subcooled RP-1 Temperature
specs.source: SpaceX Falcon 9 Full Thrust / Block 5 chilled RP-1

history: Densified subcooled propellants allow Falcon 9 Block 5 to load ~8–10% more propellant mass in the same tank volume, directly enabling booster recovery margins.
sources: NASA KSC LC-39A Propellant Storage Reference
